articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch predawn Starlink mission on President’s Day
articles.summary: The Starlink 6-103 mission is the 10th orbital flight from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in 2026. Liftoff from pad 40 is scheduled for 12:34:20 a.m. EST (0534:20 UTC) on Monday, Feb. 16.

articles.title: Replacement crew docks at space station, boosts crew back to seven
articles.summary: The Crew Dragon docked at the space-facing port of the lab's forward Harmony module at 3:15 p.m. EST, 34 hours after launch Friday from the Kennedy Space Center atop a Falcon 9 rocket.

articles.title: Crew-12 Arrives on Station
articles.summary: NASA’s Crew-12 mission docked to the International Space Station at 3:15 PM Eastern Time on February 14th, carrying 4 crew members aboard Crew Dragon Freedom.
